messages:
Alex: Heads-up — need a quick sync on the microcost dashboard we're shipping. Primary asks: cost-per-1k tokens, explicit cache vs batch savings breakdown, and what runtime fields infra must emit for accurate attribution. Who can own the ingest contract?

Maria: I can own the ingest contract but need runtime to add a few fields. Proposed minimal set: model, model_variant, route, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, kv_cache_hits, batch_size, cost_usd. Also want 'routing_policy' (e.g. 'latency', 'cost', 'fallback').

Raj: +1. Also add 'executor_type' (hosted/dedicated/private) so we can attribute reserved capacity vs hosted spend. For cost calc we need token weights: embeddings vs text. So include 'token_kind' or split tokens as Maria suggested.

Sam: For dashboard UX we should expose both "per 1k tokens" and raw token counts so product math is easy. Recommend storing raw integers and compute normalized cost in the analytics layer.

Alex: Can you paste a tiny example event payload we'll ask runtime to emit? I'll turn it into a telemetry PR.

Sam: Sure — here's a minimal example we can drop in the spec:
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_9a8b7c",
  "model": "redwood-2b",
  "model_variant": "quant8",
  "executor_type": "dedicated",
  "route": "fast-path",
  "routing_policy": "latency",
  "tokens_prompt": 120,
  "tokens_completion": 380,
  "tokens_embedding": 0,
  "kv_cache_hits": 95,
  "batch_size": 4,
  "cost_usd": "0.0036"
}
```

Maria: That looks good. Small nit: make cost_usd a string or fixed-decimal to avoid floating precision issues in downstream. Also add 'kv_cache_lookups' so we can compute hit ratio in the analytics job if runtime can't send a float.

Raj: For routing mapping — we need a lookup table from route name -> policy + tier. I'll put a small config in the repo and expose it via the console so dashboards can label by policy and tier.

Alex: Action items then: Maria to draft ingest schema PR (include kv_cache_lookups), Sam to add analytics transform to compute per-1k cost and savings breakdown, Raj to add route policy mapping config, I'll add console cards for "Cost per 1k tokens" and "KV/Batch savings %" and link to the ingest contract. Target: PRs by EOD Wednesday, dashboard preview Thu. Thanks :rocket:

ingest-bot: Created issue #452: "microcost telemetry contract + route mapping" assigned to Maria — https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/issues/452
